title: Matchday 1 — Germany run riot, drama everywhere else

slides.note: Curaçao levelled early. Then the flood. *Trust the board.*

slides.headline: Curaçao *answer* an early German strike
slides.body: Nmecha opens at six, Wirtz supplying. Then Curaçao refuse the script — Comenencia levels at 21 for the nation's first-ever World Cup goal. One-one, and briefly the giants look *mortal*.

slides.headline: The dam *breaks* either side of the half
slides.body: Schlotterbeck heads Germany back ahead at 38. Havertz converts in first-half stoppage. Musiala strikes at 47. Then the *flood* — Brown, Undav and Havertz again pile on, all the way to seven.

slides.context: Sweden run riot. Ayari *bookends* it at 7' and 90+6'. Isak turns provider three times; Rekik's 43rd-minute strike was Tunisia's only reply.
Van Dijk and Summerville each nudge the Dutch ahead. Japan *answer* both — Kamada striking at 89 to rescue a draw. Three Dutch yellows tell the story.
Goalless into the 90th — then Amad Diallo pokes home, Singo supplying. Ivory Coast booked three before the break, no reds, and held on for all three points.

slides.note: Up next: Spain v Cape Verde, Belgium v Egypt & 2 more.

stories.note: Nineteen goals across four games. The full rout, on the board.
Ivory Coast booked three before the break — and won anyway. Filed.
